en: Dependent on a state that has an object and is not a root-condition, there arises a state with an object that is a root-condition by way of root-condition.

(Abbreviated. Under root-condition there are three; under object-condition there are three; under predominance-condition there is one … pe … under prenascence and repetition there is one … pe … under non-disappearance there are three.

Dependent on a state that does not have an object and is not a root-condition, there arises a state with an object that is not a root-condition by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated. Under root-condition there are three; under object-condition there is one … pe … under non-disappearance there are three.
